title: [Decision] ui/ merge leftovers that no aftercare card names: six nested top-level docs, a second copy of four .claude hooks, an independently numbered ui/docs/adr, and a dead ui/.github/dependabot.yml
body:
Ruled: 6417494426 · letter A · 2026-10-26T13:42Z

Filing gate ②: a maintainer-only decision. Maintainer, 2026-10-26, verbatim: 「完整的评估本项目， 还有哪些可以优化的地方。包括 ci 和文档」 then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue，需要决策的立为决策卡。」 and 「低优先级的先不考虑」. Batch-of: 19 (repository evaluation 2026-10-26, `session_019a9XCWsbMFp75REzthE6cs`; 9 decision cards + 10 execution cards). Reader: the director seat presents this card in a decision batch; after the ruling the lane named under "After the ruling" dispatches. ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: REST list (439 issues), grep `ui/\.github|ui/AGENTS|ui/\.claude|nested` → 3 hits: #25880 (closed, ruled A: port the 19 repo gates), #25728 (closed), #25712 (open, dispatched: AGENTS.md / ui/AGENTS.md nesting, the 18 governance workflows, pm scripts, liveness evidence). Read #25712's scope in full: it names `ui/AGENTS.md`, the workflows under `ui/.github/`, and the two `.githooks` trees; it does not name the files below. #25831 (ui changesets) and #25832 (ui skill bundle) cover those two. **New for the remainder.**

## 维护者速读

objectui 合入 `ui/` 两天，#25712 / #25831 / #25832 / #25880 已经在收 AGENTS.md、治理 workflow、changeset、skills 和 repo-gates。还剩一组没人点名的重复面：① `ui/` 下六份顶层文档 `README.md`(470 行)、`CHANGELOG.md`(807 行)、`ROADMAP.md`、`CONTRIBUTING.md`、`QUICK_REFERENCE.md`、`LICENSE` + `LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.md`——根目录各有一份同名文件，两份 CONTRIBUTING 两套入门步骤、两份 ROADMAP 两条方向；② `ui/.claude/hooks/` 与根 `.claude/hooks/` 同名的四组守卫（guard-main-checkout、guard-main-checkout-bash、guard-shared-stash、guard-tree-enum 各带 selftest），Claude Code 只读根 `.claude/`，嵌套的一份永不执行；③ `ui/docs/adr/` 11 份 ADR 独立编号（0001 起），与根 `docs/adr/` 的 0001 重号，而 AGENTS.md 第 13 条说编号永不重分配、`check-adr-anchors.mjs` 只认根注册表；④ `ui/.github/dependabot.yml` Dependabot 只读根配置，这份是死文件；`ui/lychee.toml`、`ui/turbo.objectui.json` 同类。请裁：**A** 六份顶层文档并入根（README 的 UI 段落、CHANGELOG 作为 `@object-ui` 历史移到 `content/docs/releases/` 或保留为 `ui/CHANGELOG.md` 只读历史、ROADMAP/CONTRIBUTING/QUICK_REFERENCE 删除并在根文档加 UI 小节、LICENSE 保留因 MIT≠Apache），删重复 hooks，`ui/docs/adr` 以 `ui-NNNN` 前缀登入根注册表索引（文件不动、不改号），删死配置；**B** 只删死文件（hooks、dependabot、lychee、turbo.objectui），文档与 ADR 不动；**C** 全部保留，作为 `ui/` 子树自治的一部分。选 A / B / C？

## Governing text

- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 (as amended for the merge): the governed register already lists `ui/docs/adr/**`, `ui/.claude/**`, `ui/skills/**`, `ui/AGENTS.md`, `ui/CLAUDE.md`, `ui/.github/workflows/**` — so `ui/.claude/hooks` is governed even though nothing runs it.
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13: numbers are never reassigned; files never move between registries.
- #25712 scope items 4–5 and the `.githooks` note (comment-free quote: "Two hook trees with overlapping names: a merged pre-commit must not run objectui's root-assuming hooks").
- `scripts/ui-import/README.md`: the cutover procedure; it does not mention the files above.
- `ui/CLAUDE.md` (3 lines) points at `ui/AGENTS.md` — stays as #25712 decides.

## Premises

- P1 — `ls ui` shows README.md, CHANGELOG.md, ROADMAP.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, QUICK_REFERENCE.md, LICENSE, LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.md, lychee.toml, turbo.objectui.json; `ls ui/.github` shows dependabot.yml and workflows.
- P2 — `ls ui/.claude/hooks` → eight files, four of them byte-different copies of root hooks: `diff .claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh ui/.claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.sh`.
- P3 — `ls ui/docs/adr | wc -l` → 11; `ls ui/docs/adr | head -1` starts at 0001.
- P4 — Dependabot reads only the root `.github/dependabot.yml` (GitHub docs); the root file has no `directory: /ui` entry.
- P5 — licence: `ui/package.json` `"license": "MIT"`, root packages Apache-2.0 — the ui LICENSE file must stay.

## One-sentence problem

Two days after the merge the tree still tells a reader two ways to contribute, two roadmaps, two hook sets of which one never runs, and two ADR 0001s.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Fold the six docs into the root equivalents (keep `ui/LICENSE*`; keep `ui/CHANGELOG.md` as frozen history or move it under releases); delete `ui/.claude/hooks/*` (root hooks already guard every repo path per their headers); register `ui/docs/adr` in the root index under a `ui-` prefix without renaming files; delete `ui/.github/dependabot.yml`, `ui/lychee.toml`, `ui/turbo.objectui.json` after confirming nothing reads them. | One contributor story; the governed register shrinks by the dead hook tree; the anchor checker learns one more registry prefix (an edit to `check-adr-anchors.mjs`). | devx + skills (hooks are `.claude/**`) · 3 PRs (docs; hooks Tier S; ADR index + dependabot Tier H for `.github`) · precedent: #25880 (closed) |
| B | Dead files only. | Quick; two CONTRIBUTINGs and two ROADMAPs remain. | 1–2 PRs |
| C | Keep. | The subtree stays a repository-in-a-repository. | 0 |

## Business meaning

- A: one repository.
- B: one repository with a spare instruction manual in a drawer.
- C: two repositories sharing a lockfile.

## 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**：读者是每个打开 `ui/` 的贡献者与席位；`ui/CONTRIBUTING.md` 还在讲 objectui 独立仓的 fork 流程，照做就是错的。
- **项目长远合理性**：合并的目的（#25677）是一个仓一套治理；留下第二套顶层文档与永不执行的 hooks 与之相反。ADR 不改号、只在根索引登记前缀，守第 13 条。
- **防 AI 犯错**：席位按路径加载规则；`ui/.claude/hooks` 看起来像在守护，实际不运行——是「声明而未兑现」的治理面，正是北极星第 4 条反对的形态。
- **创业阶段不扩散**：删重复、不加门禁；ADR 索引前缀是 D5 索引脚本的一个参数，不是新工具。

## Recommendation

**A**, serialized after #25712's PR 2 lands (same directories). 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

Confidence gaps: whether `ui/turbo.objectui.json` or `ui/lychee.toml` is read by any root script or workflow (`grep -rn 'turbo.objectui\|ui/lychee' .github scripts package.json` before deleting); whether #25712's dev already removed any of these in flight — the dispatching seat re-reads #25712's PR file lists first.

## After the ruling

- A: devx seat for docs and dependabot; skills seat for `ui/.claude/hooks` (Tier S); ADR prefix rides D5's index PR if that is ruled A, else its own small PR.
- B: devx seat, one PR plus the Tier S hooks PR.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：一个仓一套治理（#25677 的目的）；ADR 不改号只登前缀，守第 13 条。
② 实际业务拉动：ui/CONTRIBUTING.md 讲的是独立仓流程，照做即错；两份 ROADMAP 两条方向。
③ 防 AI 犯错：永不执行的 hooks 是「声明而未兑现」的治理面，删除优于保留。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：删重复零新门禁；索引前缀复用 D5 的脚本。
Prior rulings read: ui merge,nested,aftercare,hooks → 3 hits (#25880 A, #25712, #25728); none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Related

#25677 (epic), #25712 (open, dispatched), #25831, #25832, #25880 (closed, ruled A).
